problems.explain: Each inch on the floor plan is 8 ft, so 5 inches is 5 × 8 = 40 ft. (Dividing would make the real thing smaller than its picture.) So 40 ft.

prompt.v: On a floor plan, 1 inch stands for 8 ft. A wall is 56 ft long. How long is it on the plan, in inches?

problems.text: scale drawing: 1 in = 8 ft; 56 ft back
problems.explain: Every 8 ft takes 1 inch, so count how many 8s fit in 56: 56 ÷ 8 = 7. (Multiplying, 56 × 8, scales the wrong way.) So 7 inches.

problems.explain: 1 : 200 means every length on the real ship is 200 times the model’s, in the same unit. 47 × 200 = 9,400 in. (Not 47 ÷ 200: the real ship is the bigger one.) So 9,400 in.
